_comment: Egg exported by Waifly - custom Go Universal runtime, self-built images.
name: Go Universal (Waifly)
author: contact@waifly.com
description:
Generic Go egg using Waifly's own self-built images (ghcr.io/waiflyhost/go).

Clones a Git repo (or use USER_UPLOAD if you upload files yourself), builds it with `go build`, then runs the resulting binary. The binary is only rebuilt when missing or when AUTO_UPDATE is enabled, so restarts are fast.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -f "${BINARY_NAME}" ]] || [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]]; then if [ -f go.mod ]; then go mod download; fi; go build -o "${BINARY_NAME}" ${BUILD_ARGS} "${BUILD_PATH}"; fi; ./"${BINARY_NAME}" ${RUN_ARGS}

config.startup: {"done":["change this text to something your app prints once it is ready"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Go App Installation Script (Waifly)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y git curl unzip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "USER_UPLOAD is set, skipping git clone. Upload your files manually."
    exit 0
fi

if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anonymous git access"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server is not empty"
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
    fi
    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo -e "pulling latest from git"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty, cloning repo"
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/go.mod ]; then
    echo "Downloading go modules"
    go mod download || true
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: GitHub/GitLab repo to clone, e.g. https://github.com/user/repo

variables.name: Install Branch
variables.description: The branch to install. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip the git clone if you are uploading files yourself.
0 = false (default), 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files from git and rebuild on every startup.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token to authenticate with git (optional, for private repos).

variables.name: Binary name
variables.description: Name of the compiled binary that go build produces and that gets executed.

variables.name: Build path
variables.description: Package path passed to `go build` (the directory containing main.go, or a ./... pattern).

variables.name: Additional build arguments
variables.description: Extra flags passed to `go build`, e.g. -ldflags="-s -w"

variables.name: Additional run arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments passed to the compiled binary at runtime.
